data.body: ARG decision (item 17): sweep approved, gate deliberately NOT enabled. Filed story fc0c-e218-8b34-4858 (43 mechanical fixes + two cluster decisions) and bug c9c6-a713-8bc6-4088 (update_priority accepts acli_cmd it cannot use). Deciding evidence: _-prefixing is not a safe universal remediation here - typed_dispatch.py:128 reads parameter names as strings and client is passed unconditionally, so renames break dispatch at runtime; and a gate would require ~17 permanent inline noqa, a discretionary per-site hatch this project has ruled against. OSS survey found zero ARG reversions across ~15 repos, but the exclusion is near-universal and always same-commit-as-adoption, so it is 'predicted the cost' not 'recanted'. Nobody documented ARG catching a real bug; rebar caught three. Revisit note recorded in .joe-janitor/tools.md keyed to the irreducible exception count the sweep will measure.
